The foreman {npc:Budrik} was robbed by the gang of {creature:The Horned Fox}: they took his 600-year-old miner's helmet that belonged to his father and grandfather. Recover it in a minotaur tower near the Dwarf Mines and Budrik gives you his spare helmet, a {item:Mining Helmet}. It also unlocks the Turmoil of War task.
Budrik has been robbed by The Horned Fox and this time it's personal!
Being able to start the Turmoil of War task of the {wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest|Killing in the Name of... Quest}
When you return the helmet to {npc:Budrik}: you can now start this task of the {wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest}.
The {wiki:Steel Helmet Quest|Steel Helmet Quest} is in the same tower: leave space and capacity for that reward too.
The {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers} and {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages} attack from range: pull them a few at a time on the upper floors.

If you are not in **Kazordoon** yet, get there by the {wiki:Steamship} (from Cormaya with {npc:Gurbasch} or from Farmine with {npc:Thorgrin}: {key:hi}, {key:kazordoon}, {key:yes}) or on foot through the mountain entrance. Leave through the main entrance of Kazordoon and follow the white line on the map (from the red X in the top-right corner) to a rope hole, where there are some {creature:Spider|Spiders}. Head **north** and go out by a ramp down, where there are {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders} and some {creature:Dwarf|Dwarves} at ground level. The **second** mine, marked with the down arrow in a red circle, is Budrik's (the cave to the north and closest to the river).
Route from Kazordoon to Budrik's mine and the minotaur tower
{npc:Budrik} is one floor below ground, inside the mine. Say {key:hi}, {key:mission} and {key:yes}. To leave the mine, climb back up the way you came down.

Keep following the white line on the map **south**, crossing two bridges and passing other mine entrances. You may run into {creature:Snake|Snakes}, {creature:Poison Spider|Poison Spiders}, {creature:Wolf|Wolves} and {creature:Bear|Bears}. At the end, use the {item:Shovel} on the {item:Loose Stone Pile} to go down.

After going down the hole, head **west** and climb up through the first rope hole. Follow the white line on the map from the red X to the green up arrow. Underground you will find {creature:Bat|Bats}, {creature:Minotaur|Minotaurs} and {creature:Minotaur Archer|Minotaur Archers}.
Climb the minotaur tower. Creatures per floor:
2 Minotaur Guards in each room (north and south)
North: 2 Minotaur Guards and 4 Minotaur Archers. South: 2 {creature:Minotaur Mage|Minotaur Mages} and 4 Minotaur Archers
North: 4 Minotaur Archers. South: 1 Minotaur Mage and 3 Minotaur Archers
The miner's helmet is behind a sealed door on the **second floor** of the tower. Go in and pick it up.

Go down the tower the same way to the ground floor, go down the rope hole you climbed up and, now underground, head back **east** to below the {item:Loose Stone Pile} hole. Climb up with the {item:Rope}. Then follow the white line on the map **north**, over the two bridges, to Budrik's mine.
Underground route (floor -1): follow the route in reverse to the hole you went down

Go back to {npc:Budrik} and say {key:hi} and {key:mission}. He keeps the old helmet and gives you his spare helmet. To return to Kazordoon, leave the mine and follow the white line on the map to the main entrance of the city.
Completing this quest lets you start the Turmoil of War task of the {wiki:Killing in the Name of... Quest|Killing in the Name of... Quest}.
